name: Prabhhans Industries Limited
about: Prabhhans Industries Limited engages in the trading of paper products. It also sells school uniforms, corporate and institutional uniforms, and other garments products. The company was formerly known as Sea Gold Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Prabhhans Industries Limited in January 2021. Prabhhans Industries Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
